subject: English
passage: Among the most popular wildlife refuges in East Africa, the Olonyiro Conservancy in Kenya welcomed approximately 320,000 in-person visitors in 2022. The conservancy also operates a network of live-streaming wildlife cameras that nature enthusiasts can watch online for free. Although there were initial concerns that people who watched the live streams would then consider an in-person visit unnecessary, conservancy administrators Dante Gabriel Rossetti and Adjoa Demir claim that their surveys of in-person visitors show that those concerns were unjustified.
prompt: Which statement, if true, would most directly support the administrators' claim?

choices.A: Most surveyed visitors to the Olonyiro Conservancy indicated that they lived somewhere other than Kenya.
choices.B: Many surveyed visitors to the Olonyiro Conservancy indicated that the live streams convinced them to plan an in-person visit.
choices.C: Many surveyed visitors to the Olonyiro Conservancy indicated that they would likely watch the live streams in order to relive their in-person visit.
choices.D: Most surveyed visitors to the Olonyiro Conservancy indicated that they were unaware of the live streams before their first in-person visit.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The passage explains that there were initial concerns that people who watched the live streams would then consider an in-person visit unnecessary, and administrators claim those concerns were unjustified. If many surveyed in-person visitors said the live streams convinced them to plan an in-person visit, this finding directly contradicts the original concern by showing that the streams actually encouraged rather than discouraged in-person visits, supporting the administrators' claim.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. Finding that most visitors were unaware of the live streams before visiting would show only that the live streams played no role in their decision to visit. This does not support the claim that the concerns were unjustified — it merely shows that live streams had no effect on these visitors, not that live streams actively encourage in-person visits.
